data.text: What happens when the ground beneath your feet isn't solid? When the very foundation of who you are — your name, your past, your memories — begins to dissolve, not into air, but into something far more terrifying: a meticulously crafted lie?
data.delivery_notes: Clinical, detached, building to a sense of dread.

data.text: This is not a story of a lost person. This is the story of a person whose self was stolen, piece by digital piece, until nothing remained but a phantom echo.
data.delivery_notes: Ominous, slow pacing, emphasizing the word 'stolen'.

data.text: But to understand how Elena Vasquez arrived at this precipice, we must go back. To a time before the ghost in the machine took hold. Three days earlier...
data.delivery_notes: Intriguing, mysterious, slightly faster tempo to transition.
